name: Lamira
source:
Lamira is an average guy who wanted nothing more than a peaceful life, but after living one for a few years, now he loathes the routine. He might look aloof, but he's actually quite down to earth and friendly. He defers to other people easily and will never refuse a favor. Selfless. Dutiful. Slightly gullible.

The village he lives in is old-fashioned and still rooted in the magic culture. He doesn't have much of an inclination for magic, but he's learned a tiny bit of healing magic.

[From [url=http://pawsalamode.com/cafechan/algormortis/]official site[/url]]
